chunks: All praise be to God who bestowed on me Ishmael and Isaac in old age. Verily my Lord listens to prayer.
ai.seo_question: What does this verse say about God hearing prayers and granting children in old age?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Ibrahim (AS) offers thanks for the miraculous birth of Ishmael and Isaac in his old age, a narrative also echoed in Surah Hud (11:69) where angels bring glad tidings. It underscores the Shia understanding of divine timing and the power of du'a, illustrating how God fulfills promises to the righteous even when natural possibilities seem exhausted.
